about_the_game:
We hope that more friends who love this type of game can participate in the trial and give any game feedback. Your support is the biggest motivation for the team! Thank you!
Discord group for communication of "Empire Game":



In the game, players need to flexibly allocate resources according to the situation to maximize benefits. Resource management and consumption strategies in the first, middle and late stages of the game determine the player's success or failure. Reasonable use of races and troop types to match, develop the best development route, and give full play to the value of each resource.



The game features nearly 10 unique races, with each race equipped with 8 types of soldiers and a wealth of neutral soldiers. Players can formulate the strongest tactics based on racial characteristics and troop types to create a powerful battle formation.



The hero system is extremely in-depth, allowing players to choose different heroes and enhance their talents and skills. Careful hero training and equipment matching can play a huge role in battles and help players achieve victory.



The game map is randomized, and players need to weigh the expansion, defense, and diplomacy strategies according to the changes in the terrain and environment. Reasonable decision-making can help players gain the upper hand in complex situations and achieve victory.



Exciting battles are perfectly blended with a fun atmosphere! The game supports up to 500 to 600 combat units on the same screen, creating a powerful and grand battlefield. The game supports up to 500 to 600 combat units on the same screen, creating a magnificent battlefield with great impact. The exaggerated and hilarious action design of the characters injects a light-hearted and witty fun into the fierce battles. With the hilarious scenes and fast pace, you can enjoy the thrill of battle with laughter!

name: Empire Game

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GT440（512M）or AMD Radeon equivalent or above
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX560se or AMD Radeon equivalent or above
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: This is a save-file turn-based strategy game inspired by the gameplay mechanics of Heroes of Might and Magic。in the Age of Empires universe and features multiple civilizations, each reflecting the unique characteristics of historical nations such as French, Chinese, Ancient Roman, and others。
supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, French, German, Indonesian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Vietnamese, Korean, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America
